name: scenarios
description: One request per everyday workload: math reasoning, code, structured output, refactoring, translation, Chinese reasoning, explanation and summarization. Measures native decode speed per scenario under the product sampling contract; answers are not graded.

messages.content: Find the number of ordered pairs (a, b) of positive integers with a + b <= 100 such that a*b + 1 is divisible by a + b. Reason step by step and put the final answer in \boxed{}.
Prove that for every integer n >= 1, the number 5^(2n+1) + 2^(n+4) + 2^(n+1) is divisible by 23. Then prove that the sum of the reciprocals of the primes diverges. Give complete, rigorous proofs.

Write a complete, well-commented Python module implementing an LRU cache with per-entry TTL, a thread-safe get/put API, O(1) operations, and a small unittest suite covering eviction order, expiry and concurrent access.
Write an idiomatic Rust library crate (lib.rs) for a bounded multi-producer single-consumer ring buffer using atomics, with safety comments on every unsafe block and unit tests.

Refactor this JavaScript into modern TypeScript with explicit types, small pure functions and JSDoc, keeping behavior identical. Return the full file.

var data=[];function load(u,cb){var x=new XMLHttpRequest();x.open('GET',u);x.onload=function(){if(x.status==200){var j=JSON.parse(x.responseText);for(var i=0;i<j.items.length;i++){if(j.items[i].active){data.push({id:j.items[i].id,name:j.items[i].name.trim(),score:j.items[i].score||0})}}data.sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score});cb(null,data)}else{cb(new Error('bad '+x.status))}};x.onerror=function(){cb(new Error('net'))};x.send()}function top(n){var r=[];for(var i=0;i<n&&i<data.length;i++)r.push(data[i].name+' ('+data[i].score+')');return r.join(', ')}

Generate a JSON array of 40 fictional library books. Each object has exactly these keys: id (string, 'B' plus 4 digits), title, author, year (1900-2025), genres (array of 1-3 strings), available (boolean), shelf (string like 'C-12'). Output only the JSON.

Design a PostgreSQL schema for a multi-tenant issue tracker (tenants, users, projects, issues, comments, labels, issue_labels, audit_log) with constraints, indexes and row-level security policies. Give the full DDL followed by five example queries.

把下面这段话翻译成自然流畅的英文，然后再给出一个更正式的版本：

在长上下文推理中，显存带宽往往比算力更早成为瓶颈。每生成一个 token，注意力层都要把完整的键值缓存读一遍；上下文翻倍，这部分读取量也随之翻倍。因此，推理引擎的优化重点从矩阵乘法逐渐转向了数据的搬运方式：如何压缩缓存、如何让一次读取服务更多的查询，以及如何把多个小算子合并成一次访存。
一个水池有甲、乙两根进水管和丙一根出水管。单开甲 6 小时注满，单开乙 8 小时注满，单开丙 12 小时放空。先开甲乙两小时，再三管齐开，问还需多少小时注满？请用中文一步步推理，并说明每一步的依据。
Explain to a new graduate engineer how speculative decoding works, why it can be exact, where the speedup comes from, and when it stops helping. Use concrete numbers and one worked example.

Summarize the trade-offs between write-ahead logging and shadow paging for an embedded database, then produce a one-page design note recommending one for a battery-powered device that loses power unpredictably.
